ipmap.factoryWarning: The devices' IP address becomes {factory}. If your computer cannot reach that network, the devices disappear after the operation; to keep them on the set's own network, change the "Factory IP address" field above.
ipmap.lcdFactoryResetHow: The same run as an assignment: the ports open one at a time, the display is found over ADB and the address is verified after it is written.
ipmap.lcdFactoryResetIntro: The Compartment LCDs on ports {ports} will be moved from set {set} to the set 1 addresses.
ipmap.lcdFactoryResetNote: Every display keeps its own last octet: 10.1.1.40, .41, … They are not gathered on one address as intercoms are.
ipmap.lcdFactoryResetWarning: During the run each display on the selected ports loses power in turn.
ipmap.theArpCacheCannotBe: The ARP cache cannot be flushed (no administrator/root). If several devices share one address they cannot all be reached in a single pass; the job waits and retries, and the result may be incomplete. For a definite answer, start the application as administrator/sudo.
ipmap.theFactoryResetJobWas: The factory reset job was queued
ipmap.thereIsAlreadyAJob: There is already a job for this switch
ipmap.thisTestToolPreparesThe: This test tool prepares the starting state for another go at IP assignment. It does not touch the PoE ports. If devices are not on their DeviceMap addresses, or two share one address, the pass repeats until the addresses are free.
ippanel.clickDefinedPort: Click a defined port to activate this switch.
ippanel.clickPhysicalPoePort: Click any physical PoE port to activate this switch and use it for the test.
ippanel.computerOnPort: the computer is on this port
ippanel.enterCredentialsFor: Enter a username and password for {switch}.
ippanel.ipAssignmentCannotStartWithout: IP assignment cannot start without credentials.
ippanel.noTargetOnSwitch: No device of the selected target group is on this switch.
ippanel.physicalTargetPort: Port {port} · physical Compartment LCD test port{state}
ippanel.portLocked: Port {port} · {reason} · left out of IP assignment
ippanel.readFromDeviceMap: The port states could not be read; the layout came from DeviceMap
ippanel.readFromSwitch: The port states were read from the switch
ippanel.theSwitchRecordWasNot: The switch record was not loaded — refresh the page
ippanel.whenThePortStatesWere: When the port states were last read
ipplan.noTargetDeviceOnThe: No target device on the selected ports
ipplan.physicalPortDiscoveryNote: Each row is a selected physical switch port. During the run, the connected LCD is matched to its DeviceMap record using its source IP and the switch MAC table.
ipplan.reviewTheCurrentAndTarget: Review the current and target IP addresses.
job.identityUnverified: Could not verify the device identity
job.networkAddressFailed: The address could not be added: {detail}
job.networkPickAdapter: Pick the adapter the switch is plugged into on the Network screen
job.networkRouteStranded: This network's route still names {address}, which the machine no longer holds; every device in it fails instantly. Take {adapter} down and up again to rebuild it.
job.telemetryFailed: MQTT telemetry could not be collected
locked.accessVerifiedGroup: Access to {device} verified · the account was applied to the group.
locked.applyToGroup: Use the same account on the other devices in the "{group}" group too
locked.noneNeedCredentials: No device is asking for credentials right now.
locked.ownAccount: An account used for this device only
locked.title: Needs credentials
locked.whatYouEnterIsKept: What you enter is kept in memory for this session only; it is written to no file and forgotten when the app closes.
locked.whereToEnter: This list holds the devices that answered a scan with “credentials required”. A switch that does not answer at all never appears here; enter its credentials from the switch card on the IP screen.
net.automaticNote: Nothing here has to be started. Opening this screen, running an IP assignment, scanning, or changing the train set all prepare the network on their own.
net.baseAddressHint: Added on the factory network. Every train set gets one more on the same pattern — set {set} means 10.{set}.1.{octet}.
net.choiceNotSaved: The interface choice could not be saved and will be forgotten when the application closes: {detail}
net.collisionNote: Collisions are checked against DeviceMap and this computer’s own addresses. A third-party device already using the address cannot be seen until a connection is tried.
net.intro: Devices are only reachable when this computer has an address on their network. An unconfigured device answers on {factory} whichever train set it belongs to, so that network is almost never the one the computer is on. The panel adds the missing addresses itself when an operation needs them.
net.noUsableAdapter: This computer has no adapter an address could be added to.
net.noneAdded: The panel has not added any address.
net.nothingRequired: The computer can already reach every network of this train set.
net.pickAdapter: Which adapter is the switch plugged into?
net.pickAdapterWhy: The panel does not guess. No adapter on this computer holds an address on the devices' network yet, so it cannot tell which cable goes to the switch — pick it once and it will not ask again.
net.reasonDevices: The devices of this train set
net.reasonFactory: The address devices leave the factory on
net.reasonSearch: The search area given on the IP screen
net.reasonSwitch: The switches of this train set
net.sessionOnly: These addresses last while the application is open; they are removed when it closes. Nothing already configured is changed.
net.title: The computer’s network
net.unsupported: Adding an address is not supported on this operating system ({system}).
overview.checkUnfinished: The check did not finish on {count} device(s)
overview.checkUnfinishedNote: Check the connection, the IP, the power or the device response.
overview.credentialsNote: What you enter is kept in memory for this session only.
overview.listUnfinished: List the devices whose check did not finish
overview.noJobHasRunThis: No job has run this session yet.
overview.noScanYetNote: Start a scan to see the current state of the devices in this set.
overview.notReadYet: The devices have not been read yet
overview.openLockedDevices: Open the devices needing a username or password
overview.scanFinishedNote: IP and SIP consistency can be reviewed on the verification screen.
overview.scanRunningNote: Devices appear here as they answer; the rest follow.
